text: The manual gives the rear wheel spindle torque as 70 Nm. Ensure both wheels are aligned correctly after adjusting the chain and before tightening the rear wheel spindle nut. Watch out: Make sure the rear wheel is fitted correctly before you ride the motorcycle.
